defensives.name: Obsidian Scales
defensives.usage_rule: Press before a known burst of incoming damage to cut damage taken by 30%; it has two charges so use it freely on telegraphed hits.

defensives.name: Renewing Blaze
defensives.usage_rule: Use when health is dropping to recover a large chunk of the damage you take over its duration as healing; pair it with Obsidian Scales for heavy hits.

defensives.name: Zephyr
defensives.usage_rule: Pop ahead of a raid-wide magical or area damage event to grant yourself and nearby allies a damage reduction; this is a group-saving defensive, so call it out.
